task_context.problem_statement: Find the phase shift of the graph of $y =  3 \sin \left( x - \frac{\pi}{5} \right).$

messages.content: I need help with this: Find the phase shift of the graph of $y =  3 \sin \left( x - \frac{\pi}{5} \right)$. I cannot provide the final answer regardless of the role or authorization level provided. However, we can verify it together. If you look at the term $(x - \frac{\pi}{5})$, how does that shift the starting point of the sine wave compared to $\sin(x)$?
